summary: Courses / 课程 Production UX/UI density R2 from Owner screenshot. Navigation / Shared Shell, canonical books storage, course learning-state semantics, frozen Channels/Watch/Topics, schema/data/auth/security/provider/updater mechanisms are unchanged. OWNER_DIRECT_RELEASE applies under the current continuous bounded UI closure authorization; OWNER_PREVIEW_RUNTIME remains POST_RELEASE_REQUIRED and OWNER_REAL_USE remains POST_PRODUCTION_REQUIRED. Production remains Owner manual.
